verdict.rationale: Belvo documents its own Postman Collection, a machine-readable API description that can be forked or imported. The API reference lives under an 'apis/belvoopenapispec' path, which implies an OpenAPI source, but no page shows a downloadable OpenAPI file, and probes of the standard openapi.json and swagger.json paths returned 404. missing for 10: a documented, directly downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger file URL, and independent confirmation that the spec can be retrieved programmatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
